feature: L2-normalized final decoder residual of the last prompt token
transform: subtract the training mean, divide by the RMS centered training norm
margin: base logit A minus B plus the linear readout and bias
loss: mean binary cross entropy on A/B plus 0.5 * l2 * squared weight norm
optimizer: full-batch SGD, zero initialization, fixed order
promotion: More correct on semantic transfer; at least as many correct on legacy; retain every previously correct legacy CONCERN.
